purpose: Test whether a factory-placeable fixed-value LC network can replace BPF-A127+ without importing its 34.54 x 9.27 x 8.89 mm body and USD 48.70 material cost.

reference.wide_stopband_gate: The reference specifies at least 40 dB from 180 to 2200 MHz. Lumped pre-layout calculation above component SRF is not accepted as proof; H3 bounded EM/S-parameter work, H6 routed extraction before order and H8 VNA measurement remain mandatory.

candidate.topology: two low-side shunt series notches, three-element band-pass core, three upper-edge shunt series notches and two high-side shunt series notches
candidate.finite_q_model: ABCD cascade with 50-ohm source/load; every inductor uses its conservative Q witness and every C0G capacitor uses Q=1200

stress_sweep.scope: pre-layout value/Q/tolerance stress; it deliberately excludes pad, via, mutual-coupling, shield and enclosure parasitics

factory_feasibility_witnesses.availability: 155 stock / 152 available, MOQ 1, USD 0.272 at quantity 1
28 stock / 25 available, MOQ 1, USD 0.1324 at quantity 1
4573 stock / 4548 available, MOQ 1, USD 0.1158 at quantity 1
8484 stock / 8343 available, MOQ 1, USD 0.0975 at quantity 1

decision.accepted: H1 accepts the LC topology, 24 x 11 mm tuning envelope, alternate/DNP pad strategy and factory-placeable precision passive families as the physical boundary; this remains materially cheaper/smaller than BPF-A127+.
decision.rejected: The stock-backed exact MPNs are only the H2 nominal fitted state, not a production freeze: the current tolerance/Q stress misses the stop mask and must be retuned in H3 before routed extraction.
decision.next_gate: H2 carries the complete tuning network and nominal engineering values into ECAD. H3 proves the topology with manufacturer models and bounded pre-layout parasitics. H6 repeats the proof with routed/extracted PCB parasitics before the H7 order, and H8 selects the production fitted/DNP state by VNA; failure returns to an exact purchased filter or a different receiver boundary.
